benchmarks.name: GET organization by slug (unique)
benchmarks.sql: SELECT id, name, status, owner_email FROM organizations WHERE slug = $1

benchmarks.name: GET appointment by booking_number (unique)
benchmarks.sql: SELECT id, status, starts_at, gross_amount FROM appointments.appointments WHERE booking_number = $1

benchmarks.name: GET EUT by transaction_ref (unique)
benchmarks.sql: SELECT id, gross_amount, status, net_to_salon FROM rms.end_user_transactions WHERE transaction_ref = $1

benchmarks.name: GET employee by org + employee_number
benchmarks.sql: SELECT id, full_name, status FROM employee.employees WHERE organization_id = $1 AND employee_number = $2

benchmarks.name: List appointments for branch (30-day window)
benchmarks.sql: SELECT id, booking_number, status, starts_at, gross_amount FROM appointments.appointments WHERE branch_id = $1 AND starts_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '45 days' ORDER BY starts_at DESC LIMIT 50

benchmarks.name: Filter appointments by status + org
benchmarks.sql: SELECT id, booking_number, starts_at FROM appointments.appointments WHERE organization_id = $1 AND status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY starts_at DESC LIMIT 100

benchmarks.name: Attendance for employee (date range)
benchmarks.sql: SELECT attendance_date, status, check_in_at, check_out_at FROM employee.attendance_records WHERE employee_id = $1 ORDER BY attendance_date DESC LIMIT 30

benchmarks.name: EUT success list for org (recent)
benchmarks.sql: SELECT transaction_ref, gross_amount, net_to_salon, occurred_at FROM rms.end_user_transactions WHERE organization_id = $1 AND status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100

benchmarks.name: Appointment + service + specialist join
benchmarks.sql: SELECT a.booking_number, a.status, a.starts_at, s.name AS service, e.full_name AS specialist, a.gross_amount FROM appointments.appointments a JOIN services.branch_services s ON s.id = a.branch_service_id LEFT JOIN employee.employees e ON e.id = a.specialist_id WHERE a.organization_id = $1 ORDER BY a.starts_at DESC LIMIT 50

benchmarks.name: EUT + appointment + branch join
benchmarks.sql: SELECT e.transaction_ref, e.gross_amount, e.commission_amount, a.booking_number, b.name AS branch FROM rms.end_user_transactions e LEFT JOIN appointments.appointments a ON a.booking_number = e.booking_ref JOIN branches b ON b.id = e.branch_id WHERE e.organization_id = $1 ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC LIMIT 50

benchmarks.name: Branch services with specialist count
benchmarks.sql: SELECT s.name, s.price, s.duration_minutes, COUNT(ss.employee_id)::int AS specialists FROM services.branch_services s LEFT JOIN services.branch_service_specialists ss ON ss.branch_service_id = s.id WHERE s.branch_id = $1 AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.price, s.duration_minutes ORDER BY s.sort_order

benchmarks.name: Invoice + line items + payment join
benchmarks.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number, i.total_amount, i.status, COUNT(ili.id)::int AS lines, COALESCE(SUM(ip.amount_applied),0) AS paid FROM rms.invoices i LEFT JOIN rms.invoice_line_items ili ON ili.invoice_id = i.id LEFT JOIN rms.invoice_payments ip ON ip.invoice_id = i.id WHERE i.organization_id = $1 GROUP BY i.id ORDER BY i.issue_date DESC

benchmarks.name: Org revenue rollup (EUT sum/count by day)
benchmarks.sql: SELECT date_trunc('day', occurred_at) AS day, COUNT(*)::int AS txns, SUM(gross_amount) AS gross, SUM(commission_amount) AS commission, SUM(net_to_salon) AS net FROM rms.end_user_transactions WHERE organization_id = $1 AND status = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

benchmarks.name: Platform-wide appointment status histogram
benchmarks.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*)::int AS n, ROUND(AVG(gross_amount)::numeric, 2) AS avg_gross FROM appointments.appointments WHERE booking_number >= 'PERF-APT-' AND booking_number < 'PERF-APT.' GROUP BY status ORDER BY n DESC

benchmarks.name: Top 20 branches by completed booking GMV
benchmarks.sql: SELECT b.name, o.slug AS org, x.completed, x.gmv FROM ( SELECT branch_id, COUNT(*)::int AS completed, SUM(gross_amount) AS gmv FROM appointments.appointments WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND booking_number >= 'PERF-APT-' AND booking_number < 'PERF-APT.' GROUP BY branch_id ORDER BY gmv DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20 ) x JOIN branches b ON b.id = x.branch_id JOIN organizations o ON o.id = b.organization_id ORDER BY x.gmv DESC

benchmarks.name: Specialist utilization (appt hours / specialist)
benchmarks.sql: SELECT e.full_name, e.employee_number, COUNT(*)::int AS bookings, SUM(a.service_duration_min)::int AS minutes, ROUND(AVG(a.gross_amount)::numeric, 2) AS avg_ticket FROM appointments.appointments a JOIN employee.employees e ON e.id = a.specialist_id WHERE a.organization_id = $1 AND a.status IN ('COMPLETED','CONFIRMED','NO_SHOW') GROUP BY e.id ORDER BY minutes DESC

benchmarks.name: Attendance present-rate by branch (window)
benchmarks.sql: SELECT b.name, COUNT(*)::int AS records, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ar.status = 'PRESENT')::int AS present, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ar.status = 'PRESENT') / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1) AS present_pct FROM employee.attendance_records ar JOIN branches b ON b.id = ar.branch_id WHERE ar.organization_id = $1 GROUP BY b.id, b.name ORDER BY present_pct DESC

benchmarks.name: Running GMV window (org appointments)
benchmarks.sql: SELECT booking_number, starts_at, gross_amount, SUM(gross_amount) OVER (ORDER BY starts_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_gmv FROM appointments.appointments WHERE organization_id = $1 AND status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY starts_at LIMIT 200

benchmarks.name: Cross-schema merchant payable vs appointments
benchmarks.sql: SELECT o.slug, COALESCE(ap.appts, 0)::int AS appts, COALESCE(eu.euts, 0)::int AS euts, COALESCE(eu.payable_accrued, 0) AS payable_accrued FROM organizations o LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS appts FROM appointments.appointments a WHERE a.organization_id = o.id AND a.booking_number >= 'PERF-APT-' AND a.booking_number < 'PERF-APT.' ) ap ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS euts, COALESCE(SUM(e.net_to_salon), 0) AS payable_accrued FROM rms.end_user_transactions e WH

benchmarks.name: INSERT appointment (single row)
benchmarks.sql: INSERT INTO appointments.appointments ( booking_number, organization_id, branch_id, branch_service_id, specialist_id, end_user_ref, end_user_name, service_name, service_duration_min, starts_at, ends_at, status, source, list_price, discount_amount, gross_amount, payment_method, payment_status ) VALUES ( $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'EU-BENCH', 'Bench User', 'Bench Cut', 30, NOW() + ($6 || ' minutes')::interval, NOW() + (($6)::int + 30 || ' minutes')::interval, 'BOOKED', 'CONSUMER_APP', 499, 0, 499, 'ONLIN

benchmarks.name: UPDATE appointment status BOOKED→CONFIRMED
benchmarks.sql: UPDATE appointments.appointments SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW(), payment_status = 'PAID' WHERE organization_id = $1 AND booking_number LIKE 'PERF-BENCH-APT-%' AND status = 'BOOKED' RETURNING id

benchmarks.name: INSERT attendance row
benchmarks.sql: INSERT INTO employee.attendance_records ( organization_id, branch_id, employee_id, attendance_date, check_in_at, check_out_at, status, source, marked_by_ref ) VALUES ( $1, $2, $3, CURRENT_DATE + ($4 || ' days')::interval, NOW(), NOW() + INTERVAL '8 hours', 'PRESENT', 'SYSTEM', 'perf-bench' ) ON CONFLICT (employee_id, attendance_date) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, updated_at = NOW() RETURNING id

benchmarks.name: UPDATE org merchant balances
benchmarks.sql: UPDATE rms.org_merchant_balances SET outstanding_amount = outstanding_amount + 10, pending_payout_amount = pending_payout_amount + 25, updated_at = NOW() WHERE organization_id = $1 RETURNING outstanding_amount, pending_payout_amount

benchmarks.name: DELETE bench appointments (cleanup slice)
benchmarks.sql: DELETE FROM appointments.appointments WHERE organization_id = $1 AND booking_number LIKE 'PERF-BENCH-APT-%' AND status = 'CONFIRMED' RETURNING id

benchmarks.name: End-user booking history by end_user_ref
benchmarks.sql: SELECT booking_number, service_name, starts_at, status, gross_amount, payment_status FROM appointments.appointments WHERE end_user_ref = $1 ORDER BY starts_at DESC LIMIT 20
